In the meantime, if you like the blue ocean look in a 16" floor piece, the Empire 16" Blue Ocean Illuminated Bar Globe is in stock — it's a floor-standing globe with the same bright blue ocean map, illuminated, and doubles as a drinks cabinet for a real conversation piece. Want me to point you to that one, or would you rather wait on the Willston?
willston 16" floor globe

The Willston is sold out right now, so I can't get that one into your cart. The closest option I have in stock that keeps the same 16" blue ocean floor presence is the Empire 16" Blue Ocean Illuminated Bar Globe — it's illuminated, floor-standing, and built as a statement piece with a drinks cabinet built in. Want me to point you there, or would you like to wait and check back on the Willston later?
i love the stand

The Empire has that same kind of striking stand presence — it's built on a floor-standing cabinet base designed to be the centerpiece of a room, with the blue ocean map glowing when lit. It's a different build than the Willston's stand, but it brings the same "stop and look at it" quality. Want the link to the Empire 16" Blue Ocean Illuminated Bar Globe?
please show it to me

The Empire 16" Blue Ocean Illuminated Bar Globe is $750 CAD, and since that's over $99, shipping is free. You'll find it under that exact name using the site search — just search "Empire 16 Illuminated Bar Globe" and you can add it to your cart right from the page.
no i don't want to pay quite that much

Totally understand — the Dawson 16" Gray Floor Globe is a nice step down from the Empire and keeps that modern, eye-catching stand style you liked, with a sleek metal base and the Designer Series map on the same 16" floor-standing scale. It's $410 CAD, so shipping is free there too. Want me to point you to that one, or is there another direction you'd like to go?
does it have the same stand

The Dawson has its own look — a modern metal stand rather than the Willston's adjustable-height gyro-matic design, but it's built in that same sleek, contemporary style and still lets the globe tilt and spin freely on its 16" floor base. If having that exact adjustable-height gyro-matic stand is the key thing for you, I'd watch for the Willston to come back in stock rather than switch styles — want me to flag that for you, or are you open to trying the Dawson's look?
